task: Summarize recent advances in transformer efficiency techniques published in 2024.
final_output: Recent transformer efficiency advances in 2024 include FlashAttention-2 improving memory-efficient attention computation, Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) with extended context scaling, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing improvements reducing compute per token, speculative decoding reducing latency, and quantization techniques like AWQ enabling deployment on smaller hardware.
expected_output: Key 2024 transformer efficiency advances: FlashAttention-2, RoPE context scaling, MoE routing, speculative decoding, quantization methods such as AWQ and GPTQ.
